content: Is your child dead? It has been given back. Is your wife dead? She has been given back. Is your estate taken away? Well, and is not that likewise given back?
author: Epictetus
story:
There is a sharp, grounded clarity in this observation. Genuine love is not a transaction where you keep score of who gave what; it is a state of being where you extend warmth and goodwill without needing to control the other person.

Across his life and work, Epictetus saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. The biggest barrier to deep connection is never external; it is our own fear of rejection. We build armor around our hearts to avoid pain, but that same armor ends up locking out the warmth and intimacy we crave.
reflectionPrompt: What current difficulty or obstacle are you facing that could become your greatest training ground?
